Who We Are

About Us

SF Get A Pro is a local San Francisco service business run by Naty Metaferia. With years of hands-on experience, we take pride in doing every job with care, precision, and respect for your home.

We know your time is valuable. That's why we show up on time, work efficiently, and leave your space clean. No hidden fees, no surprises — just quality work at a fair price.

Locally owned and operated in San Francisco
Licensed, insured, and background checked
Available 7 days a week including same-day
100% satisfaction — we don't leave until it's right

Need Answers?

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does furniture assembly cost?

Most assembly jobs start around $98 depending on the number of items and complexity.

Do you offer same-day service?

Yes, same-day availability is often possible in San Francisco based on current schedule.

Are you insured?

Yes. SF Get A Pro is insured and works carefully to protect your home and furniture.

What areas do you serve?

We serve San Francisco and nearby Bay Area locations for select jobs.

How long does TV mounting take?

Most standard TV mounting jobs take about 60–120 minutes depending on wall type and cable management.
